content.description: Two-column financial summary section on the dashboard showing Revenue (left) and Costs (right). Revenue column: Invoiced This Month (sum firmFreightInvoices.totalAmount where issuedAt >= month start, status in issued/dispatched/paid), Collected (sum paidAmount same filter), Outstanding (sum outstandingAmount). Costs column: Port Disbursements (sum pdaProformaEstimates.totalEstimate where status in approved/submitted, estimateDate >= month start), Bunker Costs (sum bfmBunkerOrders.totalAmount where status in confirmed/delivered, deliveryDate >= month start). All amounts in cents (integer), formatted with formatCompactCurrency. Positioned between Vessel Schedule Timeline and Activity Feed grid.

data_sources.revenue_invoiced: firmFreightInvoices — SUM(totalAmount) WHERE tenantId=tid AND issuedAt >= thisMonthStart AND status IN ('issued','dispatched','paid') AND deletedAt IS NULL
data_sources.revenue_collected: firmFreightInvoices — SUM(paidAmount) WHERE tenantId=tid AND issuedAt >= thisMonthStart AND status IN ('issued','dispatched','paid') AND deletedAt IS NULL
data_sources.revenue_outstanding: firmFreightInvoices — SUM(outstandingAmount) WHERE tenantId=tid AND status IN ('issued','dispatched') AND deletedAt IS NULL
data_sources.cost_port_disbursements: pdaProformaEstimates — SUM(totalEstimate) WHERE tenantId=tid AND estimateDate >= thisMonthStart AND status IN ('approved','submitted','final') AND deletedAt IS NULL
data_sources.cost_bunker: bfmBunkerOrders — SUM(totalAmount) WHERE tenantId=tid AND deliveryDate >= thisMonthStart AND status IN ('confirmed','delivered') AND deletedAt IS NULL
data_sources.note: All amount columns are integer (cents). Use existing formatCompactCurrency() helper.

layout.container: Same rounded-xl card style as other dashboard sections
layout.columns: Two columns on lg, stacked on mobile. Left = Revenue, Right = Costs
layout.row_format: Each metric: label (text-xs text-slate-500) + value (text-lg font-semibold) on same line
layout.column_header: Revenue (with DollarSign icon) and Costs (with TrendingDown icon)

acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows a 'Financial Summary' section below the Vessel Schedule Timeline
Section has two columns: Revenue (left) and Costs (right) on desktop, stacked on mobile
Revenue column shows: Invoiced MTD, Collected MTD, Outstanding — each with formatted currency value
Costs column shows: Port Disbursements MTD, Bunker Costs MTD — each with formatted currency value
All amounts queried with tenantId filter and deletedAt IS NULL
Revenue Invoiced = SUM(firmFreightInvoices.totalAmount) for current month issued/dispatched/paid invoices
Revenue Collected = SUM(firmFreightInvoices.paidAmount) for current month
Revenue Outstanding = SUM(firmFreightInvoices.outstandingAmount) for all open invoices
Port Disbursements = SUM(pdaProformaEstimates.totalEstimate) for current month approved/submitted
Bunker Costs = SUM(bfmBunkerOrders.totalAmount) for current month confirmed/delivered
Empty state: if all values are zero, show 'No financial activity this month' with link to invoicing hub
Currency formatting uses tenant's currency from existing tenantRow query
Dark mode support on all elements
edge_cases: All financial values are zero — show empty state
Only revenue exists, no costs — costs column shows $0 values (not hidden)
Very large amounts (millions) — compact format handles this (e.g., $1.2M)
Null sum results (no matching rows) — fallback to 0
Missing pdaProformaEstimates or bfmBunkerOrders data — individual sums default to 0
error_handling: Any query failure — val() fallback returns 0, component shows $0 values gracefully
Auth failure — handled by parent page redirect
security_considerations: tenantId filter mandatory on ALL queries
content.implementation_notes: Add 3 new queries to Promise.allSettled (indexes 20-22): revenue collected MTD (paidAmount sum), port disbursements MTD, bunker costs MTD. Revenue invoiced MTD already exists as query index 8. Revenue outstanding already exists as query index 10. Import pdaProformaEstimates from port-disbursement-accounting schema and bfmBunkerOrders from bunker-fuel-management schema. Create FinancialSummary client component at src/components/dashboard/financial-summary.tsx. Component receives: invoicedMtd, collectedMtd, outstanding, portDisbursements, bunkerCosts, currency.
affected_files: src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx — import pdaProformaEstimates + bfmBunkerOrders, add 3 queries, extract data, render FinancialSummary
testing_requirements: Financial summary renders with correct formatted values
Two-column layout on desktop, stacked on mobile
Empty state renders when all values are zero
